main_text.p: tur nullas fcripsisse Homilias Hieronv-mum, hoc solum colligitur Hieronymum quasdã Origenis in Lucam Homilias à s[?] in Latinum conversas asserere, quod nor[?] diffiteor, neque quæ de Ruffino observat Vir doctus ut Prologum & Homiliarum translatione Hieronymo adscribat. Vnum illum rogo; nùm videlicet Hieronymus tractatus illos septem in Psalmos quorum meminit in eodem Catalogo post Homi-lias in Lucam, nùm, inquam, tractatus illos transtulerit modò, aut scripserit; Ex hypothesi Viri docti scribere non potuit, quia Homilias nunquam scripsit, Tracta-tus autem Latinis, ut optimè novit, idem sunt quod Græcis Homiliæ, ideóque Sophronius vertit Homilias septem; Ergo Tractatus septem in Psalmos à decimo usque ad decimum sextum transtulisse Hieronymum dicendum est; quæ cùm ita sint frustrà scribit eruditus Pearsonius pag. 118. ad majorem argumenti sui confirmationem addi posse ex Ruffini Præfatione ad libros de Principijs, Hieronv-mum ultrà 70. libellos Origenis quos Homileticos appellavit transtulisse in Latinum, quod de 70. fatetur Hieronymus Apologiâ primâ p. 492. G. cum 491. F; Vtrúm-que verùm esse agnosco, sed Vindiciarum Auctori nocere magis quàm favere per-

page.notes: Line "in Latinum conversas asserere, quod nor" reads "quod" followed by a mark and "nor"; the word is doubtful. The first word of the page is a fragment and continues from the previous page. Printed "à s[?]" at the end of the third line is cut off at the scan edge and uncertain. "Hieronv-" at the line end before "mum" is doubtful as printed. The hyphenated line-end "per-" is kept as printed. The word "Homilias" in italics is set in roman-italic in the original. The footer "Digitized by Google" is omitted.
